name: Ishan International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, Ishan International Ltd is engaged in the business of contracting of machinery and engineering projects.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3][4]
a) IIL is an ISO certified heavy engineering company which is in the Engineering, Procurement and Construction business. 
b) It deals in engineering Goods and spares, construction material, pollution control and renewable 
energy projects.
c) The company is engaged in marketing/ selling projects that focus on supplying machines, erection /installation, commissioning and operational training for sugar plants, hydro power plants and pollution control systems, etc.
d) It also provides high-end engineering services and solutions for all types of activities in Hydro Power, Sugar & Pollution Control Systems.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.76 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 112 to 29.2 days.
Promoter holding has increased by 1.02% over last quarter.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 122 days to 66.7 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.10% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -18.8%
